name: assignment-report-checker
description: Check an assignment report against its prompt and point out missing requirements or unsupported claims.

# Assignment Report Checker

When asked to review an assignment report:

1. Read the assignment prompt and the report being reviewed.
2. Treat the prompt as the source of truth. Check whether the report addresses each requested output and accurately describes the work done.
3. Identify missing requirements, unclear statements, and claims that are not supported by the report or other provided evidence.
4. Give concise, actionable feedback. Do not rewrite or edit the report unless explicitly asked.
5. Do not invent requirements, research, tests, or actions that were not performed.
